title: Kirench1k Crafts
description: Makes saddle, nametag, and more items craftable!
body:
This mod adds **Vanilla+ crafts** like to **saddles** or **nametags**, A great addition to your **vanilla+** modpack! 

This mod is like a datapack inside a mod so it works on server side.

Im planning to update it until I run out of crafts.
